Shared rules for the dependable stint
This section shows the plain rules

Companion Animal Travel Desk Procedures

This section sets the routine steps for the Companion Animal Travel Desk and helps staff give steady support to travelers, crews, and cabin teams with care and clarity. The desk must use calm language, confirm details before action, and keep records complete and readable so each trip is handled with the same reliable standard. When a traveler asks for guidance, staff should listen first, then give clear instructions that match the booking, the route, and the animal's needs. Any concern about comfort, containment, or boarding readiness should be shared at once with the welcome team so the next step stays smooth.

Staff must review documents, carrier details, and cabin notes before release for travel, and they must raise any gap without delay. If an animal needs special attention, the desk should pass the note to the cabin team in clear words that describe the support needed during flight. The desk should never guess about suitability or leave a record incomplete, because careful handoff protects both the traveler and the animal. Courtesy is required in every exchange, even when changes are made at short notice, and the message should always be practical rather than lengthy.

When speaking with travelers, staff should use simple phrases, confirm understanding, and offer the next action in a kind tone. If the animal arrives with signs of distress or the container appears unsuitable, the matter must be escalated through the proper channel before boarding moves ahead. The desk should also keep the welcome team informed about any late change that may affect the boarding flow or the comfort of the animal. This practice supports smooth coordination and helps Aurelia Skyways present a dependable service.

All desk notes, verbal handoffs, and service updates must reflect the same facts so that no team receives mixed guidance. Staff should protect traveler privacy, handle concerns discreetly, and limit discussion to those who need the information for service delivery. If there is uncertainty at any point, consult the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor for direction before proceeding. Companion Animal Travel Desk
